title: IDOC Policies and Procedures on Releases

communications.subject: Illinois Freedom of Information Act. Request: IDOC Policies and Procedures on Releases
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

Policies and process documents relating to release of an individual in custody once a judge has decided that they are to be released:
	- Steps and timeline to release a individual in custody after a judge has decided they should be released
	- Rules or guidelines on maximum wait times to be released
	- Resources that people entitled to while waiting to be release 
          E.g. food, water, access to a phone, bathroom
	- Resources that a released individual is entitled to receive once they are free to go
          E.g. personal property, bus passes, warm clothing in winter, information and resources
                   if they can make a call, how many, how long it can last

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

4

To the FOIA Coordinator,

Pursuant to the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, MCL 15.231 et seq., I am requesting records related to the Coordinated Assessment Model (CAM) monitoring and evaluation process referenced in the report titled "Strategic System Improvement Plan for Detroit’s Homelessness Response System, 2024-2028."

Please provide:

- Any CAM monitoring and evaluation plan, framework, protocol or similar document developed or used to assess the performance of CAM and Detroit’s coordinated entry system.
- Any completed monitoring reports, evaluation reports, scorecards, dashboards, summaries or findings produced pursuant to that plan from January 1, 2025 through the date of this request.
- Any implementation schedule, work plan or status document showing whether the CAM monitoring and evaluation activities identified in the Strategic System Improvement Plan have been completed, are ongoing or remain pending.

If any responsive records are maintained by or shared with the Homeless Action Network of Detroit (HAND) but are also in the City’s possession, custody or control, please include those records.

If any portion of a responsive record is exempt from disclosure, please redact only the exempt material, release all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions, and cite the specific statutory exemption relied upon.

Please provide records electronically where available.

I request a waiver or reduction of fees because disclosure will contribute to public understanding of the performance and oversight of Detroit’s publicly supported homelessness response system and is not being sought for commercial purposes.

Thank you,
Aaron Mondry
